comments.author: renzynx
comments.text:
Created comprehensive implementation plan in Obsidian:
- Projects/Docix/Backend Image Processing Plan.md
- Projects/Docix/Redis Session Migration Plan.md  
- Projects/Docix/ADR-001 - Redis Infrastructure.md
- Projects/Docix/Implementation Checklist.md

Key technology choices:
- asynq (github.com/hibiken/asynq) for Redis job queue
- bimg (github.com/h2non/bimg) for image processing with libvips
- go-redis (github.com/redis/go-redis/v9) for Redis client

6-week implementation timeline across 4 phases.
